crossRefs.note: “In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied. The travelers walked…
When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were distressed), then the people hid themselves…
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not…
For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes…
There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of…

translations.web: In those times there was no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands.
translations.bsb: In those days there was no safety for travelers, because the residents of the lands had many conflicts.
translations.kjv: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
translations.asv: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in; but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the lands.
